steps.title: Отметь, чему научился
items: ✓ ask someone to say it again — Sorry, could you repeat that? · Please could you speak up?
✓ say why you could not hear — You’re breaking up. · It’s too noisy in here.
✓ ask what a word means — What do you mean by…? · Could you explain?
✓ say you have lost the thread — Sorry, I’m a bit lost.
✓ check something before you agree — So do I need to…?
✓ say what you must and don’t have to do recycled — You must get insurance. You don’t have to pay it all today.
